description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

Fixes:
- The randnsfw row in the subreddit picker now shows without the mod row.
- Turning Block ads on enables pro features right away.
- "Revoke data consent for ads" is hidden while Block ads is on.
- If you had Inline images off, inline videos stay off after updating.
- imgur albums no longer flash a placeholder with inline images and videos off.
- Subreddit descriptions are handled more robustly.
- Includes 1.10.1-dev8.
